name: travel
description: Trip planner: builds complete trip plans (round-trip tickets + dated day-by-day itinerary + budget + destination research). Also does standalone flight/train ticket search (Amadeus live offers, Brave web fallback).

tools.name: travel
tools.description: Travel assistant with three actions. action=plan: THE trip planner — use for ANY request to plan/organize a trip or holiday (e.g. 'plan a 7-day trip to Tibet'). Provide origin, destination, date and days (or return_date); it searches round-trip tickets and returns a dated plan framework (ticket shortlist, budget worksheet, day-by-day skeleton, research checklist, next steps). You MUST then complete the plan in the same turn: research the checklist with web_search, fill every day (morning/afternoon/evening, meals, travel legs, rough costs), complete the budget, save the finished plan with write_file and present it. action=search: standalone ticket search for one route+date, ranked top-N table. action=rerank: re-sort the last search by price/duration/balance. Live prices need Amadeus keys in the travel config section; without them the tool falls back to web estimates.

action.description: plan = full trip plan (preferred for trip requests), search = tickets only, rerank = re-sort last search

origin.description: Departure city / airport IATA code (ask the user if unknown)

days.description: Trip length in days including both travel days (plan only, default 7)

return_date.description: Optional last day YYYY-MM-DD (plan); if omitted = date + days - 1. For search: makes a second ticket lookup automatically

interests.description: plan only: what the traveler enjoys (e.g. 'history, hiking, photography'); steers the research checklist

max.description: search only: max offers to fetch, default 20

top.description: search only: how many ranked results to show, default 5
